valuation.method: Forward Adjusted Net Income (ANI) per share x justified P/E at the 12-month target date (FY2027E ANI/share)

bear.driver: Slower SRE growth from spread compression and lower alternative investment returns, with multiple compression

base.driver: Management-targeted >20% FRE growth and ~10% SRE growth supported by record $114B quarterly origination and $1.074T AUM

bull.driver: Above-target FRE expansion (>20%), Athene alternative returns above 11% baseline, and multiple expansion

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E ANI/share of $9.85, the $123.47 close implies 12.5x P/E; the Street consensus target (~$145-$148) implies ~14.7x-15.0x at base EPS, or $10.00-$10.21 EPS at 14.5x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $9.85 (+8.0 pp of price return).
valuation.watch_metric: Fee-Related Earnings (FRE) growth, Spread-Related Earnings (SRE) ex-notable items, and quarterly gross origination volume
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 earnings release and FY2026 Form 10-K (expected February 2027)

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 earnings on November 3, 2026 ($2.07 ANI/share vs. $2.22 consensus, record $802M FRE, and $909M SRE ex-notables), most covering analysts trimmed price targets (TD Cowen $154->$136, Piper Sandler $159->$145, BMO $134->$124, Barclays $157->$156) while JPMorgan raised to $157 from $153. The sample of 5 named analysts averages $143.60 (+16.3% upside), closely aligned with our $142.83 base case (+15.7% upside). Target horizons are marked null where brokerages did not explicitly state 12-month horizons in the cited summaries.
